texts:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very eager to play. She asked her mom if she could invite a friend over to play. Her mom said yes, so the little girl ran off to invite her friend.
When her friend arrived, they decided to play a game. They each picked a bulb and had fun pretending to plant flowers in a pretend garden.
The little girl had a great time with her friend. They played together until it was time for her friend to go. When her friend left, the little girl was sad but still very eager for their next play date.

Once upon a time, there was a fat parent. Every day, the fat parent loaded the car with bags full of food. Off the fat parent drove to visit many friends. Every day, the fat parent brought food and presents for the friends. The friends were so happy and thanked the fat parent for the gifts. 
But when the day was over, the fat parent got too tired. So, the fat parent would load the car and go home to rest. Everyone loved the fat parent and were always happy to see them. 
The end.

Once upon a time there was a boy. The boy wanted to buy something. He went to the store and asked the man for a case. The man was very harsh and said no. The boy was sad but he went home. 
The next day the boy asked his father for some money. His father gave him some money to buy the case. 
The boy went back to the store and asked the man for a case again. This time the man was not so harsh and said yes. The boy was so happy and bought the case.
He took the case home and put all of his toys inside of it. He was never sad again because now he had a pretty and useful case. The End.

Once there was a girl who was walking in the park. She noticed a helpless pigeon on the ground. She tried to help it but the pigeon was scared and wouldn't move. So the girl decided to push it gently with her foot. It worked. The pigeon flew away. She felt happy and relieved that she helped the helpless pigeon. The girl smiled and waved goodbye as the pigeon flew away.

Once upon a time there was a little boy. He had a very sad look on his face. His name was Timmy. 
One day, he saw a wagon filled with hay. He took some hay and hid it in an old barn.
He felt so guilty, so he decided to take the hay back. He asked his mommy to help, and they filled the wagon with hay again.
When they were done, Timmy felt better. He was no longer guilty. 
Finally, with a big smile, he went back to playing with his friends. 
The end.

Once upon a time there was a fairy who was very sad. She was very lonely and had no one to turn to. One day she decided to try and heal herself. She flew over the world, looking for a cure to her sadness. Eventually she found something that made her happy - a bitter apple! The fairy took a bite of the apple and it healed her broken heart. She felt so much better and was even happier than before! She flew back to her home and shared the apple with her fairy friends. From that day on, the fairy was never lonely again and the bitter apple had helped to heal her.

Once upon a time, there was a red mine. It was mine all by itself. Every day, the mine had something special to do. Today, the mine was to complete a task.
The mine worked hard on the task. It tried its best to finish it. Finally, the mine was done. The task was complete!
The mine was so happy. It danced and sang. Everyone around could see how happy it was.
The mine was proud of itself. It had completed its task all by itself. After a while, the mine went back to its red home, feeling glad it had finished its job. 
The end.

Mary walked down the street with her mom. She saw a figure at the park that seemed very old. The figure was wearing a big hat, a long coat and was walking very slowly. Mary knew the figure was elderly.
Her mom stopped and said hello to the figure. Mary heard them chatting happily. She saw the figure smile and was happy too.
They talked for a while before the figure started walking away. Mary and her mom waved goodbye.
Mary felt happy when she saw the elderly figure. She seemed so nice and friendly. Mary smiled and looked forward to seeing the figure next time.

Once upon a time there was a brown junk. It had lots of pieces that wouldn't stay together. One day, a kid came by and saw the junk. She wanted to fix it up.
The kid grabbed some spray and started spraying the junk. The aerosol made the brown junk look shiny and new. Now it was easier to fit the pieces together. 
The kid kept spraying until everything was attached. She looked at the junk with pride. Now it was nice and new! She was very happy and went off to play with her new toy. 
The end.

Once upon a day, two elderly men were separated. They were sad and did not understand why. Over the following days, they each tried to find the other. They wandered around, looking for clues. Finally, one elderly man found the other. They smiled and hugged tight. They were overjoyed to be together again. From that day on, they never wanted to be separated again.
